select sum(oor.return_rpt_cash) as returnRptCash, sum(oor.return_cash) as returnCash, sum(oor.return_commision_fee) AS orderReturnCommissionFee, sum(oor.return_member_discount) AS returnMemberDiscount, sum(oor.return_shipping_fee) AS returnShippingFee, IFNULL(SUM(oor.return_cash),0) as sellOnReturnCash, IFNULL(SUM(oor.return_commision_fee),0) as sellOnReturnCommission FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob on oor.order_id = oob.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og on og.order_id=oor.order_id WHERE oob.original_order is not null and oor.shop_id = #{shopId} and oob.pay_code != 13 and oob.payment_code != 3 and (oor.return_type in (1, 2) or (oob.virtual_goods = 0 and oob.is_cancel = 2)) and oor.order_is_settlement = '0' and oor.return_state in (2, 4) and oor.return_finish_time >= #{dBefore} and oor.return_finish_time <= now()

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ore.return_cash),0)as selfSellingReturnCash, IFNULL(SUM(ore.return_commision_fee),0)as selfSellingReturnCommission FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return ore LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og on og.order_id=ore.order_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON og.goods_id = gc.goods_id AND og.common_id = gc.common_id WHERE og.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ore.return_cash),0)as sellOnReturnCash, IFNULL(SUM(ore.return_commision_fee),0)as sellOnReturnCommission FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return ore LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og on og.order_id=ore.order_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON og.common_id = gc.common_id WHERE gc.dealer_goods_flag = 1 AND og.order_id = #{orderId}
select return_code FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return where order_id = #{orderId} limit 1
select return_payment_voucher FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return where order_id = #{orderId}

select ob.shop_id,ob.order_id,ob.seller_user_id , ob.seller_user_name,oor.return_code, sb.shop_type, oor.return_method_status ob.order_receiver_contact FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor on ob.order_id = oor.order_id left join ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb on sb.supplier_shop_id = ob.shop_id where ob.jd_order_id = #{jdOrderId}
select order_id from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods where jd_returen_order_id = #{jdReturenOrderId}
